Plugin.Name: Fejes Mover Monitor
Plugin.Overview: Hungarian, US English and German Mover dashboard and open-file monitor for Unraid 7.x. Observer mode by default. Advanced mode adds opt-in age-filtered native movement for cache/Filmek to the array, skipping young, incomplete, active and open content, with SHA-256 and metadata verification. Selective movement requires the reviewed existing threshold script and user-share torrent paths. Installation never starts movement or creates a schedule. Owner tests used self-created files outside Emby; production-media movement, NAS reboot persistence and broad compatibility remain unverified. Experimental beta.
